0.2.5.en: testing flow icons and removed devices from the app.

1.0.0.en: Initial release of F1 Tracker Pro. Adds notifications for all F1 session types (FP1/2/3, Qualifying, Sprint, Race), race finished trigger with winner, dashboard winner variables per round, and driver/constructor standings actions.

1.0.1.en: Remove seconds from time unit options, fix start time to use user timezone, clean up and rename action tokens.

1.0.2.en: Add F1 Calendar dashboard widget: full season schedule with gold/silver/bronze podium badges per race.

1.0.7.en: Fix widget rendering: use public/ folder and onHomeyReady pattern.

1.1.0.en: Add five new dashboard widgets: flip-clock race countdown, driver standings, constructor standings, drivers podium (top 3), constructors podium (top 3). Fix cancelled race display in calendar (scribble strikethrough, correct sort order). Fix flip-clock animation timing. Update author info and descriptions.

1.1.1.en: Hotfix: prevent widgets from capturing scroll events on mobile, so the Homey dashboard scrolls normally when swiping over a widget.

1.1.2.en: Fix: 'starts now' triggers (race, qualifying, session, etc.) now fire correctly. Sessions that just started were incorrectly dropped from the scheduler lookup before the trigger could evaluate them.

1.1.3.en: Fix: 'race finished' trigger now fires correctly. Empty winner results were cached for 6 hours, preventing retries when race results were not yet published at the time of the first check.

1.1.4.en: Fix: calendar widget now shows podium badges immediately after a race. Result caches are cleared when race_finished fires, and empty caches retry after 5 minutes instead of waiting 6 hours.

1.1.5.en: Add subtle orange highlight for the Dutch GP row in the calendar, and for Max Verstappen in driver standings and podium widgets.

1.2.0.en: New dashboard widgets: redesigned drivers standings with hero card (photo, points, wins, podiums, poles), constructor standings hero with team car, weekend schedule widget with circuit SVG and live session indicator, race finished trigger with winner tokens, FP1/2/3 session triggers, driver and constructor standings flow actions, Dutch GP and Verstappen orange accent. Bug fixes: flow trigger run listeners, trigger deduplication.

1.2.1.en: Fix: 'race finished' and 'starts in' triggers no longer repeat after an app restart. Trigger deduplication is now persisted to settings so it survives reboots.

1.2.2.en: Update App Store listing: shorter app description and refreshed widget preview images.

1.2.3.en: Fix: widgets no longer show a blank white screen on first load. Homey.ready() is now called immediately so the widget is always visible, even when F1 data is still loading.

1.2.4.en: Fix: widgets no longer show a blank white screen on first load (all 7 widgets). Fix: circuit SVG now displays correctly in the Weekend Schedule widget — corrected the SVG source path and fixed the Red Bull Ring circuit mapping.

1.2.5.en: Fix: Weekend Schedule widget text is now readable in light mode. Replaced hardcoded white colors with theme-aware colors that adapt to both light and dark mode.
